name: Sumbangan Baja
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 1995.
story: Sumbangan Baja produced a 1995 Massey University thesis, 'Land use changes on the Hautere Plains: a study using digital image analysis and geographic information systems'. The study examined land-use and land-cover change on the Hautere Plains near Ōtaki using image analysis and GIS.

The surviving thesis is direct evidence of a New Zealand remote-sensing and spatial-analysis contribution in the mid-1990s. This entry concerns the New Zealand research, without attributing later work in other countries to the development of GIS in New Zealand.
